extraction.name: WebWalkerQA
extraction.description: A benchmark for evaluating LLMs on web traversal tasks, where models must navigate a website’s subpages to extract information systematically. It includes 680 queries from four real-world scenarios across over 1373 webpages.
extraction.creator: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was built in a two-stage funnel annotation pipeline: first, GPT-4o recursively traversed official websites to collect sub-links and pages, then it constructed queries from the gathered page information and filtered them for naturalness and short entity answers; second, crowd-sourced human annotators rewrote and calibrated the synthetic questions and answers for correctness and consistency.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Official websites and their accessible sub-links/subpages from four real-world domains: conference, organization, education, and game.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: A two-stage funnel annotation strategy combining LLM-based and human annotation: GPT-4o performed initial annotations by traversing official websites, constructing queries from page information, and filtering legitimate queries; then crowd-sourced human annotators rewrote and calibrated the questions and answers and performed quality control and filtering to refine the final QA pairs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: No inter-annotator agreement or formal annotation quality analysis is reported; quality is described only as human quality control/filtering and manual verification.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4o was used for initial synthetic QA annotation/generation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Traverse official websites recursively, collecting information on accessible sub-links and their respective pages; verify and filter for legitimate queries that deviate from natural, human-like phrasing, retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities; human annotators can rewrite and calibrate the questions and answers to ensure the QA pairs are correct and consistent.
